description: An immutable update copies only the objects on the changed path and reuses every untouched branch by reference.
The Proxy Immer passes to a recipe. Mutations on it are recorded and turned into a new immutable state.
`produce(recipe)` without a base returns `(state, ...args) => nextState`, ready to use as a reducer.
Immer freezes the states it produces, so accidental mutations throw instead of silently corrupting data.
Hook from `use-immer`: `const [value, update] = useImmer(initial)`; `update` accepts a recipe or a new value.
`current(draft)` snapshots the draft's present value; `original(draft)` returns the value before the recipe ran.
